description:
MeteoEurope1km archives on Zenodo (Europe, 1 km, 1961-2020, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF), free.

    Rasters are Equi7 Europe (EPSG:27704), Int16 in tenths of the unit (°C, mm, hPa), NoData -9999.

period.description: Normal period for ltm_day / ltm_mon_ann; default both
period.title: Period

product.description: day (one archive per year), mon (one per decade), ann (1961-2020), ltm_day / ltm_mon_ann (normals), ltm_diff (1991-2020 minus 1961-1990)
product.title: Product

variable.description: tmean, tmax, tmin, prcp or slp (sea-level pressure, daily only)
variable.title: Variable

years.description: Years 1961-2020; required for day and mon
years.title: Years

name: list_gridded_files
title: List MeteoEurope1km grid archives
